checks: deployed NFT, cartridge and item contracts expose their declared interfaces
mint creates the parent NFT and its owner-controlled custody account
cartridge nested in the parent account resolves launch ownership and onchain metadata
parent owner publishes hash-matched executable bytes entirely into chain storage
parent ownership transfer updates launch authority and invalidates old epoch signatures, including return transfer
manifest revisions clear stale content and optional freeze preserves the executable commitment
native-currency item sale pays the creator-selected receiver and deposits items in the NFT account
creator can switch to a chosen ERC20 and buyers pin payment terms to their reviewed quote
parent owner executes an ordinary item transfer from NFT custody
parent account receives and sends native currency through owner execution
environment: Ganache 7.9.2 isolated in-memory EVM, chain 31337, Shanghai
scope: Normal deployment, custody, ownership, manifest, signature epoch and payment flows. No live-chain transaction or audit claim.
